title: Early Angiotensin II in the Emergency Department
official: ANGIOtensin II for Septic Shock in the Emergency Department: ANGIO-ED Study
summary: This pilot study will enroll 20 patients with septic shock and require emergent vasopressor support in the emergency department (ED). The primary objective of the study is to determine the feasibility of early peripheral administration of angiotensin II for treatment of septic shock in the ED

sites.f: University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics
